title: REGRESSED — Enter on the amended deny row reverts the amendment instead of submitting; the first Enter is silently swallowed (Write and Bash dialogs alike)

The second Enter (on the now-unamended `No`) denies normally: `⎿  Error: User denied Write`, the model acknowledges, and the turn ends. suspects: the permission-dialog key handler — Enter appears to be consumed by the amend toggle rather than by the confirm action when the amended variant is active. Sweep #1 (qa3-04) recorded this same Enter firing the deny immediately, so the confirm path worked then and does not now.
